fixtures.fixture: PF-1 a Page with no file

state.alsoTrue: PG-2 as the example data has it today (file null) is the same case.

steps.event: He opens the project's Pages list.
steps.expect: Draft notes is a normal row: 'no Lane · Shelvorn · 1h ago', no Live or Public mark, Visibility Private in the Mac table.

steps.event: A card whose first Page reference is PG-9 is open (set pageRefs to PG-9 on any waiting card in test mode).
steps.expect: Its Evidence shows a Page tile with the title and 'No file yet'. The tile is not a link, and the heading shows no 'See all on Page'.

steps.event: He opens the Page itself from the list.
steps.expect: Suggestion: the head shows as usual and the body says 'No file yet' outside any frame; ⋯ offers Copy link but not Make public, since there is nothing to publish. The design lead's call.

expect: Nothing in this fixture reaches the example data or its counts.

fixtures.fixture: PF-2 made public, then taken back

state.base: the example data as pages.json restates it

steps.event: He opens the card 'Make "Search results layout" public?' (row 9 of 11 in the Queue) and picks A.
steps.expect: A one-way pick: above it the red block '! One-way change: cannot be undone' with the risk text; Send asks once, 'Send A? This cannot be undone.', with 'Confirm: send A' and 'Back'.

PG-2 is public at version 2, made public by the Captain at 10:00 AM. The Pages list row gains the Public mark; the viewer head reads 'Bot-made Page · ● Public, version 2' with Copy public link and Make private. 'Update public version' is not shown: version 2 is the current version.

steps.event: He makes it private from ⋯, or Dr. Kivo does it after he says so in chat (the ruling: him or any bot on his word).
steps.expect: At once the head reads 'Bot-made Page · Public, removal pending'. It never says private until the Pages host confirms. The Public mark stays until then.

steps.event: The Pages host confirms the removal.
steps.expect: The Public mark is gone and Visibility reads Private. ⋯ offers Make public... again. Anyone who opens the old public link sees 'This Page is no longer available.' Copies made while it was public cannot be recalled.

afterStep2.answeredView: dr-kivo-2 is listed as 'You: A · 10:00 AM · Dr. Kivo' (suggestion)

expect: The answered card stays in the Answered view after the Page goes private again; making it private is not an answer to a card.

fixtures.fixture: PF-3 a version that fails to load

state.alsoTrue: PG-3's version 2 file set to pages/fx-missing-v2.html (also absent) is the second case.

steps.expect: The head (title, Lane, maker, updated, Bot-made Page) shows as usual. Where the Page would be: 'This Page did not load.' with a working Try again button. Loading kept the frame's size.

steps.event: He taps Try again while the file is still missing.
steps.expect: The same message returns; no success is reported; the button stays.

steps.event: (Second case, from the example data with PG-3's version 2 file missing.) He is reading PG-3 version 1 and taps Show on 'Version 2 is ready.'
steps.expect: Version 2 does not load: 'This Page did not load.' with Try again. Suggestion: version 1 stays readable behind it until he leaves, and the 'Version 2 is ready' line stays so he can try again.

expect: the design spec puts Try again inside the frame; the flow draws it outside the Page. The design lead's call.
The two missing file paths do not exist on purpose; no other fixture or example file points to them.

fixtures.fixture: PF-4 a newer version arrives while he reads

state.base: the example data as pages.json restates it (PG-3 open at version 1)

steps.event: At 10:00 AM he returns to PG-3, still open at version 1 (opened 9:20 AM).
steps.expect: A calm line 'Version 2 is ready.' with [ Show ] sits above the Page. The text he was reading has not moved; nothing jumps.
The Page frame now shows version 2 (pages/bridge-runbook.html, with the step 'Undo a batch that fails.'). The line is gone. The head's updated time reads 'updated 9:35 AM'.

steps.event: He opens PG-3 fresh from the list instead.
steps.expect: It opens at version 2 with no 'Version N is ready' line: that line shows only to someone already reading an older version.

expect: Version 1 stays kept as a file, so step 1 shows version 1 as it was.

fixtures.fixture: PF-5 a newer private version than the public one

state.base: the example data as pages.json restates it (PG-3 public at version 1, version 2 private)

steps.event: He opens PG-3 and looks at the Public line.
steps.expect: 'Bot-made Page · ● Public, version 1', Copy public link, Make private, then 'Version 2 is newer and still private.' and [ Update public version ].

Only he can do this. It asks once, like Make public, for the exact version: '! Make version 2 public?' with the same three warnings, the private-data check and a public preview. A bot that wants it updated asks with a one-way Task Card instead.
The public line reads 'Public, version 2' and the 'newer and still private' line is gone. Whether the version 1 link keeps working is not ruled (the design lead's call).

expect: The Queue is unchanged by this fixture: no card is involved when he does it himself.
